利用ACCESS建立药物相互作用和配伍禁忌处方分析系统
黄培良 $^{1}$ 陈芃 $^{1}$ 郝建 $^{1}$ 丁有奕 $^{1}$ 陈烁 $^{1}$Establishing Prescription Analysis System of Drug Interaction and Incompatibility Using ACCESS / HUANG Pei-liang, CHEN Peng, HAO Jian, et al//China Digital Medicine.-2010 5(8): 87 to 88 Abstract To realize analysis on prescription drug analysis and incompatibility, use ACCESS to establish prescription analysis system of drug interaction and incompatibility through rapid retrieval and large storage of the computer. Result shows, this system, which is easy and convenient to operate and use, has provided the clinical pharmacist and clinical medicine for rational use of medicines.Keywords drug interaction, compatibility of medicines, prescription analysis system, ACCESS Corresponding author Chaozhou Central Hospital, Chaozhou 521000, Guangdong Province, P.R.C.药物相互作用和配伍禁忌是药师对处方适宜性审核的一项主要内容 $^{[1]}$ ，是处方调剂和药物咨询的重要工作，因此药师对药物的了解不能仅限于药品名称、适应症等常规知识，还要求药师对药物有全面掌握，但要求药师靠记忆掌握海量的相关知识不现实，且药师之间知识业务能力的不同也可能在处方审核上存在差异，临时查阅说明书工具书费时费力，因此根据药房和临床药学的工作特点，应用Office2003中的ACCESS程序设计并建立了我院的药物相互作用和配伍禁忌处方分析系统。
